newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Winterthur opens up, speculation swirls.
newsitem.headline: Winterthur opens up, speculation swirls.

text.p: Shares of Winterthur Insurance opened higher after financier Martin Ebnner said his BZ group of investment funds had raised its stake to 18.3 percent at the end of June from 14.5 percent in mid-May.
He declined to give more details about his plans for the stake in Winterthur, whose shares opened up 32 Swiss francs at 1,470. They were slightly easier in early business.
"The question now is, what will happen to the stake (around 18 percent) controlled by Ebner," Zurich Cantonal Bank asked in a market note. "The price fantasy about Winterthur thus increases."
